LanguageData.Gun_PPD-34_RWP.label: PPD-34
LanguageData.Gun_PPD-34_RWP.description: The PPD-34 is a Soviet submachine gun designed in the early 1930s. Featuring a high rate of fire and chambered for 7.62×25mm rounds, it functions as a mid-range weapon suitable for suppressing enemy targets. Its drum magazine allows for sustained fire, though its design may affect handling and accuracy. Ideal for close combat or as a support weapon in raids.
